messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT ALERT - model-quality-regression detected for rw-1-13B-quant at 1802003456. Trigger: automated evals show increase in hallucination rate on subset 'payments-prompts' and error-rate spike on production scoring. Paging oncall-ml.

oncall-ml: I’m on it. seeing a 12% increase in factual-errors on the last 6h eval slice. Latency OK. Origin looks like a model variant rollout that happened ~1802002000.

oncall-ml: Quick mitigation: recommend pinning serving-group 'prod-chat' to rw-1-13B-stable (previous pinned v2024-11-03) and rollback the rolling deploy of rw-1-13B-quant. Will coordinate with eng-runtime for immediate action. @eng-runtime please confirm.

eng-runtime: Copy. Starting rollback now. Will ramp to 100% pinned to rw-1-13B-stable within next 10m and drain existing KV caches for the quant variant.

sre-jen: tagging for visibility. Any customer-facing impact identified yet? severity estimate?

oncall-ml: Early signal: a small subset of customers using high-temperature safety prompts observed quality degradation. Roughly 3% of calls to prod-chat in last hour. Candidate severity: S2 (customer-impacted but partial).

pm-luca: We should prepare a short status page update and a customer email for affected accounts. Support will need a template.

support-alex: I can draft the support template. Do we have a list of affected customers? If it's only those on experimental routing to quant model, we can target them first.

eng-runtime: Rollback complete. All prod-chat traffic pinned to rw-1-13B-stable. Rolling metrics show error-rate returning to baseline in the past 3m. Recommend leaving pin for 24h while we investigate offline.

oncall-ml: Good. I'll kick off a quick bisect job to confirm the regression root-cause. For now, agree to pin for 24h and open a follow-up incident for RCA.

incident-bot: Action recorded: model pin applied by eng-runtime at 1802003612. Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring.

sre-jen: Draft status page message below (please review):

"Status: Degraded - Resolved / Mitigated\nSummary: We detected a model quality regression affecting the 'rw-1-13B-quant' variant serving the prod-chat route which caused an increase in incorrect responses for a subset of requests. We rolled back the variant and pinned traffic to 'rw-1-13B-stable'.\nImpact: Partial quality impact for ~3% of requests to prod-chat between 18:20 - 18:50 UTC (mitigated at 18:52 UTC).\nCurrent status: Mitigated - traffic pinned, monitoring.\nNext update: 24h or after RCA."

pm-luca: LGTM, shorten time windows to relative terms for customers. Also include guidance: "No action required unless you observe continued regressions; contact support if you rely on the quant variant".

support-alex: Customer email template (support thread stub):

"Hi <CustomerName>,\n\nWe want to let you know that earlier today our platform detected a quality regression in one of our model variants (rw-1-13B-quant) that may have affected some responses for requests routed to that variant. We have rolled back the change and pinned traffic to the stable variant. You should not see further issues; if you do, please reply and include request IDs or example prompts.\n\nWe’re investigating root cause and will follow up with details and any recommended changes.\n\nThank you for your patience,\nRedwood Support"

legal: keep the wording non-committal on SLA credits until we know scope. Good to include "We are investigating" and avoid promising root cause ETA.

eng-runtime: For the engineering playbook: quick pin command we used (internal):

```
# pin model for route
POST /v1/internal/route-pin
{
  "route": "prod-chat",
  "model": "rw-1-13B-stable",
  "duration": "24h",
  "reason": "incident 1802003456 - quality regression"
}
```

oncall-ml: Also adding the safe rollback checklist we used:
1) Pause rollout in control plane.\n2) Pin traffic to last-known-good model.\n3) Drain/flush KV cache for the bad variant.\n4) Notify support + status page.\n5) Start bisect / eval job.

ops-maya: Noting that internal monitoring tag 'eval-hallucination' should be throttled to avoid noise, will tune alert thresholds after RCA.

oncall-ml: Bisect job kicked off. Preliminary hint: quantization changes to attention kernel seem correlated. Will share logs in the RCA ticket.

support-alex: I'll queue the customer emails to accounts flagged by routing metadata. Draft subject: "Notice: temporary model variant rollback". Will share drafts for legal review before send.

pm-luca: Need internal comms snippet for execs. Draft: "We identified a model quality regression in an experimental variant; rollback applied and traffic pinned to stable. No widespread outages; small set of customers affected. Investigating cause and will update by EOD."

sre-jen: Oncall handoff - @oncall-ml I need to hand this off as I go offline in 20m. Please include runbook steps in the incident ticket. Any blockers?

oncall-ml: I’ve noted next steps in the ticket and added eng-runtime as primary. No blockers.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated -> monitoring at 1802003618. Pager schedule: eng-runtime primary follow-up.

eng-runtime: Follow-up items: collect model traces, confirm KV cache flush success, and submit a PR to revert the quant kernels until safe tests added.

oncall-ml: Closing this thread for live coordination. RCA follow-up ticket: INC-1802003456-RCA. Will post analysis and test artifacts there. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:

support-alex: tagging thread for customer-sent status once legal signs off.

legal: approved support message with minor wording changes. Good to go.

pm-luca: Final note for model pinning guidance (public/internal): always have a 1-click pin fallback in the console and verify canary + rollback steps in staging before promoting quantized kernels. Add to runbook.

eng-runtime: added to runbook. closing here.
